title: GHSA-6prc-h956-hxjq: Filesystem Path Treats Any Prefix Before "://" as a Root, Letting Paths Escape Their Base Directory
content:
<html><head></head><body>Affected versions
Symfony Filesystem versions >=5.4.0, <5.4.56, >=6, <6.4.50, >=7, <7.4.23, >=8, <8.1.11 are affected by this security issue.
The issue has been fixed in Symfony Filesystem 5.4.56, 6.4.50, 7.4.23, 8.1.11.
